items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: One with Eleanor Powell and W.C. Fields and people like that.

ctx.x: And a pretty good cast and so on. And then I did a lot of independent pictures. One with Eleanor Powell and W.C. Fields and people like that. And that was with United Artists. And then I did a couple over at Fox, when they figured everybody was making musicals, they'd try it. Actually, I'm speaking of Republic, which was where they made Westerns. But they decided to make musicals, and that was pretty farcical.
This was -- your band was always featured in all these?
